arxiv-1905-02110.title: On the Entanglement Cost of One-Shot Compression
arxiv-1905-02110.creator: Shima Bab Hadiashar, Ashwin Nayak
arxiv-1905-02110.description: Abstract We revisit the task of visible compression of an ensemble of quantum states with entanglement assistance in the one-shot setting. The protocols achieving the best compression use many more qubits of shared entanglement than the number of qubits in the states in the ensemble.

arxiv-2111-15538.title: Peaks of cylindric plane partitions
arxiv-2111-15538.creator: Dan Betea \addressmark 1, Alessandra Occelli \addressmark 2, \addressmark 3
arxiv-2111-15538.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Dan Betea \addressmark 1, Alessandra Occelli \addressmark 2, \addressmark 3. We study the asymptotic distribution, as the volume parameter goes to 1, of the peak (largest part) of finite- or slowly-growing-width cylindric plane partitions weighted by their trace, seam, and volume. There are two natural asymptotic regimes depending on the trace/seam parameters, and in both cases we obtain asymptotics governed by finite temperature (periodic) analogues of the Bessel and Airy gap probabilities from random matrix theory.

arxiv-2204-07998.creator: Zhiyu Li, Xikui Ma, Christophe Caloz
arxiv-2204-07998.description: Abstract – This paper addresses the problem of wave scattering at a moving interface formed by a space-time modulation step. Specifically, it derives, using the technique of frame hopping with Lorentz transformation, the formula for the corresponding critical angle beyond which the transmitted field is evanescent. arxiv-2204-09563.title: Interatomic potentials: Achievements and challenges
arxiv-2204-09563.description: Abstract Interatomic potentials approximate the potential energy of atoms as a function of their coordinates. Their main application is the effective simulation of many-atom systems. Here, we review empirical interatomic potentials designed to reproduce elastic properties, defect energies, bond breaking, bond formation, and even redox reactions.

arxiv-2306-14834.title: Scalable Neural Contextual Bandit for Recommender Systems Conference: ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining Workshop on Multi-Armed Bandits and Reinforcement Learning 2023; Los Angeles; CA Price: 15.0
arxiv-2306-14834.creator: Zheqing Zhu, Benjamin Van Roy
arxiv-2306-14834.description: Abstract . High-quality recommender systems ought to deliver both innovative and relevant content through effective and exploratory interactions with users. Yet, supervised learning-based neural networks, which form the backbone of many existing recommender systems, only leverage recognized user interests, falling short when it comes to efficiently uncovering unknown user preferences.

arxiv-2308-09580.title: On a generalization of quasi-metric space
arxiv-2308-09580.creator: Sugata Adhya and A. Deb Ray
arxiv-2308-09580.description: Abstract . We find an extension of the quasi-metric (to be called g g -quasi metric) such that the induced generalized topology may fail to form a topology. We show that g g -quasi metrizability is a g g -topologically invariant property of generalized topological spaces.

arxiv-2406-16747.title: Sparser is Faster and Less is More: Efficient Sparse Attention for Long-Range Transformers
arxiv-2406-16747.creator: Chao Lou, Zixia Jia, Zilong Zheng, Kewei Tu
arxiv-2406-16747.description: Abstract Accommodating long sequences efficiently in autoregressive Transformers, especially within an extended context window, poses significant challenges due to the quadratic computational complexity and substantial KV memory requirements inherent in self-attention mechanisms. In this work, we introduce SparseK Attention, a novel sparse attention mechanism designed to overcome these computational and memory obstacles while maintaining performance.

arxiv-2409-14827.title: AIM 2024 Challenge on Video Saliency Prediction: Methods and Results
arxiv-2409-14827.creator: Andrey Moskalenko, Alexey Bryncev, Dmitry Vatolin, Radu Timofte, Gen Zhan, Li Yang, Yunlong Tang, Yiting Liao, Jiongzhi Lin, Baitao Huang, Morteza Moradi, Mohammad Moradi, Francesco Rundo, Concetto Spampinato, Ali Borji, Simone Palazzo, Yuxin Zhu, Yinan Sun, Huiyu Duan, Yuqin Cao, Ziheng Jia, Qiang
arxiv-2409-14827.description: Abstract This paper reviews the Challenge on Video Saliency Prediction at AIM 2024. The goal of the participants was to develop a method for predicting accurate saliency maps for the provided set of video sequences. Saliency maps are widely exploited in various applications, including video compression, quality assessment, visual perception studies, the advertising industry, etc.

arxiv-2412-18063.title: LMRPA: Large Language Model-Driven Efficient Robotic Process Automation for OCR
arxiv-2412-18063.creator: Osama Hosam Abdellaif, Abdelrahman Nader Hassan, Ali Hamdi
arxiv-2412-18063.description: Abstract This paper introduces LMRPA, a novel Large Model-Driven Robotic Process Automation (RPA) model designed to greatly improve the efficiency and speed of Optical Character Recognition (OCR) tasks. Traditional RPA platforms often suffer from performance bottlenecks when handling high-volume repetitive processes like OCR, leading to a less efficient and more time-consuming process.

arxiv-2509-00892.title: Response Matrix Estimation in Unfolding Differential Cross Sections
arxiv-2509-00892.creator: Huanbiao Zhu, Andrea Carlo Marini, Mikael Kuusela, Larry Wasserman
arxiv-2509-00892.description: Abstract The unfolding problem in particle physics is to make inferences about the true particle spectrum based on smeared observations from a detector. This is an ill-posed inverse problem, where small changes in the smeared distribution can lead to large fluctuations in the unfolded distribution. The forward operator is the response matrix which models the detector response.

arxiv-2510-03976.title: EQUILATERAL TRIANGULAR WAVEGUIDES, MODAL STRUCTURE, ATTENUATION CHARACTERISTICS AND QUALITY FACTOR.
arxiv-2510-03976.creator: Francis Emenike Onah, Julio C. Gutiérrez-Vega
arxiv-2510-03976.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Francis Emenike Onah, Julio C. Gutiérrez-Vega. Equilateral triangular waveguides are one of the very few special kind of waveguides, whose field solutions can be constructed without necessarily solving the Maxwell’s equations. Solutions can be obtained simply by superposing some plane wave solutions and requiring the solutions to obey the necessary boundary conditions for each modes, as would be expected of any Maxwell equation’s solution or that of any Helmholtz equation resulting from the problem of Heat flow, membrane vibrations, etc.

pmc-10707034.title: Extracellular Matrix Deposition Defines the Duration of Cell Sheet Assembly from Human Adipose-Derived MSC
pmc-10707034.creator: Valentina S Glazieva, Natalya A Alexandrushkina, Peter P Nimiritsky, Maria A Kulebyakina, Roman Yu Eremichev, Pavel I Makarevich, Marco Tatullo
pmc-10707034.description: Cell sheet (CS) engineering using mesenchymal stromal cells (MSC) draws significant interest for regenerative medicine and this approach translates to clinical use for numerous indications. However, little is known of factors that define the timing of CS assembly from primary cultures. This aspect is important for planning CS delivery in autologous and allogeneic modes of use.

pmc-11268934.title: Long‐term climate warming and extreme cold events driving ecological shifts in a deep oligo‐mesotrophic lake
pmc-11268934.creator: Kexin Zhu, Rong Wang, Hengshuai Qiu, Yu Zhao, Peng Xing, Jianan Zheng, Yanjie Zhao, Wenxiu Zheng, Xiangdong Yang
pmc-11268934.description: Deep lakes are critical for freshwater storage, yet they are struggling against major ecological issues from climate change and nutrient pollution. A comprehensive understanding of internal feedback mechanisms is crucial for regulating nutrients in these lakes. A five‐year study was conducted on the diatom community and environment in Lake Fuxian, China's largest deep freshwater lake, which is becoming eutrophic.

pmc-11345910.title: Epidermoid cyst in the anus: A case report of an unusual location
pmc-11345910.creator: Yousef Alsaffaf, Ahmed Aldolly, Maisoun Shikh Saeed
pmc-11345910.description: Introduction and importanceEpidermoid cysts are generally seen as benign skin conditions characterized by the formation of nodules that are enclosed and located just beneath the epidermal layer.Case presentationThis report presents the case of a 32-years-old woman with a mass that has been progressively growing for 11 years, situated at the right anal verge.

pmc-11347682.title: Recall of ibrutinib and issues with therapeutic approval
pmc-11347682.creator: Colton Lipfert, Myung Sun Kim, Alyson Haslam, Vinay K Prasad
pmc-11347682.description: rawal from the US market. Ibrutinib, a first-in-class inhibitor of Bruton’s tyrosine kinase (BTK), showed encouraging results for MCL at the American Society of Hematology’s annual conference in 2012. Wang et al reported that 68% of patients with MCL (75/111) who received ibrutinib had an objective response, with few serious adverse events.

pmc-11475808.title: The Interlinking Metabolic Association between Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and Cancer: Molecular Mechanisms and Therapeutic Insights
pmc-11475808.creator: Abutaleb Asiri, Ali Al Qarni, Ahmed Bakillah, Elena-Raluca Nicoli
pmc-11475808.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and cancer share common risk factors including obesity, inflammation, hyperglycemia, and hyperinsulinemia. High insulin levels activate the PI3K/Akt/mTOR signaling pathway promoting cancer cell growth, survival, proliferation, metastasis, and anti-apoptosis. The inhibition of the PI3K/Akt/mTOR signaling pathway for cancer remains a promising therapy; however, drug resistance poses a major problem in clinical settings resulting in limited efficacy of agents; thus, combination treatments with therapeutic inhibitors may solve the resistance to such agents.

pmc-12533055.title: A multimodal uncertainty-aware AI system optimizes ovarian cancer risk assessment workflow
pmc-12533055.creator: Xiaodong Wang, Xiaohui Lv, Jingwen Wang, Lulu Zou, Zijun Chen, Ruiyu Zhao, Lisha Zhao, Min Zhao, Xinlei Zhang, Boan Zhang, Jiahao Zhang, Yiteng Zhu, Xin Shi, Yan’e Gao, Minghui Liu, Lirong Ai, Liming Wang, Xiyang Liu, Hong Yang
pmc-12533055.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Accurate ovarian cancer screening and diagnosis are critical for patient survival. We present UMORSS, an AI-assisted diagnostic system integrating ultrasound (US) imaging and clinical data with uncertainty quantification for precise ovarian cancer risk assessment. Developed and evaluated using a multicentre dataset (7352 patients, 7594 lesions, 9281 US images), UMORSS employs a two-phase approach: Phase I rapidly triages low-risk lesions via initial US analysis, and Phase II provides uncertainty-aware multimodal analysis for complex cases.

pmc-12536430.title: Streamlining wearable data integration for EHDS: a case study on advancing healthcare interoperability using Garmin devices and FHIR
pmc-12536430.creator: Somayeh Abedian, Eugene Yesakov, Stanislav Ostrovskiy, Rada Hussein
pmc-12536430.description: IntroductionPatient-Generated Health Data (PGHD) collected through wearable devices such as smartwatches offers new opportunities for personalized care, chronic disease management, and preventive health. Despite this potential, technical, regulatory, and interoperability challenges still limit the integration of PGHD into healthcare systems, especially in relation to standards such as Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) and the European Health Data Space (EHDS).

pmc-12946293.title: Effectiveness and safety of 3% polidocanol foam sclerotherapy in hemorrhoidal disease: a multicenter, prospective study
pmc-12946293.creator: Zhitong Yu, Tianyu Zhou, Yongduo Yu, Xuegui Tang, Shuxin Zhang, lin Peng, Zhiming Ge, Zhongan Guan, Xiangan Zhang, Yuedong Liu, XiaoJun Sun, Yue Xu, Wei Yang, Rong Wang, Xiangdang Hu, Jihua Gao, Shiyong Xin, Xiaojian Li
pmc-12946293.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). AimTo evaluate the effectiveness and safety of 3% polidocanol foam sclerotherapy (PFS) injection under anoscopy in the treatment of hemorrhoidal disease (HD) compared with rubber band ligation (RBL).MethodThis was a multicenter, open-label, prospective, observational study that enrolled 222 patients with Goligher grade I, II, or III HD (internal or mixed), who were treated with 3% PFS or RBL, which depended on the physician’s assessment and the patient’s willingness.

pmc-13162430.title: Retrieval‑augmented large language models for depression screening and suicide risk stratification
pmc-13162430.creator: Wenbo Xie, Xulai Song, Zerui Lu, Gaoqiang Fei, Yujia Zhou, Siqi Ding, Fengyi Zuo, Bangyu Wu, Tianhao Gu, Lin Xu, Xiaomeng De, Bin Zhu
pmc-13162430.description: BackgroundDepression imposes substantial individual and societal burdens, yet more than 80% of cases remain undetected in non‑psychiatric settings, and approximately 15% of individuals with severe depression die by suicide. Existing screening methods are limited by subjective self‑report, fragmented care pathways, and stigma‑related underutilization.

pmc-13611068.creator: Analina Emmanouil, Argyro Achilia, Elissavet Rousanoglou
